written.headline: SemiAnalysis releases GDPx benchmark; Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 scores 12%
written.summary: SemiAnalysis unveiled the GDPx benchmark on Nov. 2, 2026, testing 206 agentic tasks across 11 professional domains. Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 achieved the highest average score of 12.0%.

written.headline: OpenAI cuts fundraising target by $10 billion, seeks $20 billion at $1.25 trillion valuation
written.summary: OpenAI lowered its latest funding round goal to $20 billion, down from $30 billion, while keeping a $1.25 trillion valuation. The company has secured $11 billion so far and expects a first close below the target, with a later retail offering for wealthy investors.

written.headline: Bites raises $40 million Series A to expand AI‑driven frontline training platform
written.summary: Bites, an Israeli AI startup that creates short branded videos for frontline workers delivered through WhatsApp, SMS, Slack and other channels, secured $40 million in Series A funding led by PeakSpan Capital.

written.headline: Google’s Project Suncatcher satellite generates first AI response in orbit
written.summary: Google’s prototype Suncatcher satellite, launched on Oct 1, ran the Gemma 4 language model on a data‑centre‑class TPU and returned a haiku about space during its first ground‑station pass.
